facts.fact: The Federal Ministry of Health's NHMIS annual report for 2021 states that the facility NHMIS/M&E focal person collates the paper daily registers into the monthly summary form and submits it to the LGA office by the 7th, where the LGA M&E focal person enters it into DHIS2 by the 14th.
facts.system: National Health Management Information System (NHMIS), DHIS2

facts.fact: The Federal Ministry of Health reports 32,192 NHMIS monthly summary reports received on the national DHIS2 instance of 38,999 expected in December 2021 (82.5%), up from 22,363 of 39,742 in January 2021 (56.3%), and about 80% for the year; the reports are keyed at LGA level from facilities' paper forms.
facts.system: National Health Management Information System (NHMIS), DHIS2

facts.fact: The report states that the 56th National Council on Health approved harmonised NHMIS tools with a single national DHIS2 instance for routine data reporting, domiciled at the Department of Health Planning, Research and Statistics of the Federal Ministry of Health, DHIS2 having been introduced in 2013 for the monthly aggregation of facility service statistics; the approval is undated, so the fact is dated to the report's year.
facts.system: National Health Management Information System (NHMIS), DHIS2
